title: Mapping the interaction between Trim28 and the KRAB domain at the center of Trim28 silencing of endogenous retroviruses.
authors: Taka, Jamie R H; Sun, Yunyuan; Goldstone, David C
journal: Protein science : a publication of the Protein Society
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold2建模KRAB-ZFP的KRAB结构域与共抑制因子Trim28卷曲螺旋的蛋白-蛋白结合界面，虽非TF-DNA直接互作，但属转录调控复合物界面建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Transcription of endogenous retroviral elements are tightly regulated during development by members of the KRAB-containing zinc finger proteins (KRAB-ZFPs) and the co-repressor Trim28 (also known as Kap-1 or Tif1beta). KRAB-ZFPs form the largest family of transcription regulators in mammals and initiate transcriptional silencing by tethering Trim28 to a target locus. Subsequently, Trim28 recruits chromatin modifying effectors resulting in the formation of heterochromatin. In the present study, we identify surface exposed residues on the central six turns of the Trim28 coiled-coil region forming the binding interface for the KRAB domain. Using AlphaFold2 (AF2) we provide high confidence models of the interface between Trim28 and the KRAB domain and identified leucine 301 on each chain of the Trim28 monomer to act as a pin extending into a hydrophobic pocket on the KRAB domain surface. Site directed mutations in the Trim28-KRAB binding interface abolished binding to the KRAB domain. Our work provides a detailed understanding of the specific interactions between the KRAB domain and the Trim28 coiled-coil and how this interaction may be regulated during silencing events.
abstract_zh: 内源性逆转录病毒元件的转录在发育过程中受到含KRAB锌指蛋白（KRAB-ZFPs）家族成员及共抑制因子Trim28（也称为Kap-1或Tif1beta）的严格调控。KRAB-ZFPs构成哺乳动物中最大的转录调节因子家族，通过将Trim28锚定至靶位点来启动转录沉默。随后，Trim28招募染色质修饰效应因子，导致异染色质的形成。在本研究中，我们鉴定了Trim28卷曲螺旋区域中央六个螺旋转角上的表面暴露残基，这些残基构成与KRAB结构域结合的界面。利用AlphaFold2（AF2），我们提供了Trim28与KRAB结构域之间界面的高置信度模型，并鉴定出Trim28单体每条链上的亮氨酸301作为销钉，延伸至KRAB结构域表面的疏水口袋中。Trim28-KRAB结合界面上的定点突变 abolished 了与KRAB结构域的结合。我们的工作提供了对KRAB结构域与Trim28卷曲螺旋之间特异性相互作用的详细理解，以及这种相互作用在沉默事件中可能如何被调控。
